```{r envision_paths, include=FALSE}
.envision_input <- tryCatch(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), error = function(e) "")
.envision_candidates <- unique(c(
  Sys.getenv("ENVISION_PROJECT_ROOT", unset = ""),
  if (length(.envision_input) && nzchar(.envision_input)) dirname(.envision_input) else character(),
  getwd()
))
.envision_candidates <- .envision_candidates[nzchar(.envision_candidates) & dir.exists(.envision_candidates)]
.envision_config <- ""
.envision_cursor <- ""
for (.envision_start in .envision_candidates) {
  .envision_probe <- normalizePath(.envision_start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    .envision_candidate <- file.path(.envision_probe, "R", "envision_paths.R")
    if (file.exists(.envision_candidate)) {
      .envision_cursor <- .envision_probe
      .envision_config <- .envision_candidate
      break
    }
    .envision_parent <- dirname(.envision_probe)
    if (identical(.envision_parent, .envision_probe)) break
    .envision_probe <- .envision_parent
  }
  if (nzchar(.envision_config)) break
}
if (!nzchar(.envision_config)) stop("No se encontró R/envision_paths.R")
options(envision.project_root = .envision_cursor)
source(.envision_config)
```

```{r}
All_Metadata <- read.csv(project_file("Calculations", "Matlab", "Temporal_coloumap__plots", "Nueva carpeta", "All_Metadata.csv"), sep = ";") %>%
  filter(Prof =="5") %>%
    filter(St !="4") %>%
    filter(St !="5")
```

```{r}
All_Metadata$mont  <- factor(All_Metadata$mont, levels = c("Winter", "Spring","Summer"))
```


```{r}
# Barplots by day
NO2_plot <- ggplot(All_Metadata, aes(x=day, y=no2, fill = )) +
   theme_few(base_size = 10, base_family = "") +
  theme(plot.subtitle  = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0)) +
   theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))+
   theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, size=8, face = "bold")) +
   theme(axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, size=12, face = "bold")) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    labs(title = "NO2", tag = "")+
  ylab("") +
  xlab("Day") +
facet_grid(St~mont) + # scales = "free_y"
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 16))
NO2_plot
ggsave(figure_file("NO2_plot.pdf"))


```

```{r}
desvestp <-function(x){sqrt(sum((x - mean(x))^2)/(3))} # función desviación estándar poblacional
errorstandar<-function(x){sqrt(desvestp(x)/sqrt(3))} # función error estándar

```

```{r}
NO2_mean <- NO2 %>%
 group_by(mont, St) %>%
dplyr::summarise(mean=mean(no2), sdp=desvestp((no2)), errorestandar=errorstandar((no2)), n=n()) %>% #calculamos media y desviacion estandar
ungroup()
```

```{r}
plot_Total_Chla <- ggplot(Total_Chla_mean, aes(x=St, y=mean)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", color="black", position=position_dodge()) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean - errorestandar, ymax=mean + errorestandar), width=0.1, position=position_dodge(0.9)) +
  labs(x = "",y = "")+

  theme_few () +
  ggtitle ("Total_Chla")+
  theme (plot.title = element_text(size=rel(1.25),
                                   vjust=2,
                                   face="plain",
                                   color="black",
                                   lineheight=1.5))+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))+
  theme(axis.text = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size =10))+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size=10))+
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size=10))+
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size=10))+



  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,10))+
  facet_wrap(~mont)
```

```{r}
  theme(axis.text = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size =10))+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size=10))+
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size=10))+
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size=10))+



  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,4))+
  facet_wrap(~mont)
```
